mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_video_record(user_id, video_id, last_watch_time, watch_duration, play_count, is_finished, duration, last_update_time, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{videoId}, #{lastWatchTime}, #{watchDuration}, #{playCount}, #{isFinished}, #{duration}, #{lastUpdateTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT last_watch_time FROM user_video_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND video_id = #{videoId}

SELECT r.video_id AS videoId, v.cover_url AS coverUrl, v.title AS title, v.duration AS duration, r.last_watch_time AS lastWatchTime, r.is_finished AS isFinished, r.last_update_time AS lastUpdateTime FROM user_video_record r JOIN video v ON v.id = r.video_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND v.status = 1 ORDER BY r.last_update_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_video_record r JOIN video v ON v.id = r.video_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND v.status = 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_video_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND video_id = #{videoId}
